analysis.analysis: A library of dated objects is composed as a database without its dates. The field reads the library for the range it gives, the Qumran scrolls closing before 70 CE and the other sites' finds running to the eleventh century, and the composition kept the technology and the partner and dropped the funders.
analysis.d: THE LEON LEVY DEAD SEA SCROLLS DIGITAL LIBRARY, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'a free, searchable online database created by the Israel Antiquities Authority in partnership with Google.' Multispectral imaging at '12 different wavelengths', thousands of fragments 'discovered in the Judean Desert between 1947 and the early 1960s', search filters, the P.A.M. negatives, the library's link. Six cards: the library's own site, a blog, the Hebrew University, two IAA videos, the Friends of the IAA.
analysis.d_full: THE LEON LEVY DEAD SEA SCROLLS DIGITAL LIBRARY, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'a free, searchable online database created by the Israel Antiquities Authority in partnership with Google.' Multispectral imaging at '12 different wavelengths', thousands of fragments 'discovered in the Judean Desert between 1947 and the early 1960s', search filters, the P.A.M. negatives, the library's link. Six cards: the library's own site, a blog, the Hebrew University, two IAA videos, the Friends of the IAA.
findings: THE LIBRARY HELD. The IAA as maker, the spectral images and 'digital scans of historic Palestine Archaeological Museum photographic negatives from the 1950s' are the record's ('Examine high-resolution spectral images of manuscript fragments and browse scans of negatives (PAM) from the 1950s'). Checked 2026-10-31 against the Revelation First census record of 2026-10-30 and the sources it saved.

THE PARTNER KEPT, THE FUNDERS DROPPED. 'created by the Israel Antiquities Authority in partnership with Google.' Card 5 holds both in one sentence: 'With the generous lead support of the Leon Levy Foundation and additional generous support of the Arcadia Fund, the IAA and Google joined forces'. The composition keeps the sentence's second half and omits the funders whose name the library bears.

THE DATES ABSENT. The record's two findings are dates: 'Scroll dates range from the third century bce (mid–Second Temple period) to the first century of the Common Era, before the destruction of the Second Temple in' 70 CE, and the oldest known copies of biblical texts among the fragments. The composition dates the discovery (1947 to the early 1960s) and gives the scrolls no date.
FIGURES FROM THE CARDS. The discovery years ('between 1947 and the early 1960s') and the search filters are card 2's; only '12 different wavelengths' has no source.
